checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are 854x480 (16:9); the clip is stated as 10s and frames span 1s to 9.5s.

must.item: Lonely bus stop at night with wet surfaces
must.why: An empty glass shelter on a wet, reflective street at night, with no people.

must.item: Subdued lighting, unhurried melancholy peaceful mood
must.why: Dark, cool blue with amber streetlights; calm and moody. Rain falls steadily, which is slightly heavier than 'after rain'.
Slow push-in is clear across frames, and falling rain is visible.

must.item: Silent, no titles, captions or dialogue
must.why: The assistant says audio was off. No overlaid titles appear. Only in-scene signs are present.

faults.what: Rain is still falling, so it looks like during rain rather than after rain.
Small unreadable sign and poster glyphs appear in the scene, and the neon on the left is blurry. These are minor AI artefacts.
The push-in makes the shelter frame swallow the view toward the end, with the right pillar dominating the frame.

summary: A moody, cinematic empty bus shelter on a wet night street with a slow push-in and falling rain, matching the brief well, though it is still raining and has some minor sign artefacts.
